context: A mom hears about her young son's day
purpose: Teach: 思いつき/はなれ/溢れる/心情/各々/持ち込ん/見受け/ノン

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、今日のクラス、皆思いつきで絵を描いて、楽しかった!
lines.en: Mom, today our whole class just drew whatever we felt like, and it was so much fun!
lines.style: Quick, breathless opening—words tumbling out. Bright and genuine wonder. No filter, just pure delight at wanting to share this moment.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ふふ、各々の色が溢れる教室だったのね。
lines.en: Oh, a classroom where everyone's own colors were shining through.
lines.style: Soft, almost dreamy warmth. She's picturing it. Pleased at what this tells her about her son. Gentle and unhurried.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 絵の具、持ち込ん友達からもらって描いたよ。
lines.en: I used paints a friend brought—they let me use theirs!
lines.style: Small lift of pride on the sharing detail. Still animated but a beat more focused now, proud he remembered to acknowledge the kindness. Eager for her to notice too.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お友達の優しい心情、見受けるね。
lines.en: You could really see how kind your friends are.
lines.style: Not quite a question, but offered softly like she's naming something she noticed in how he told the story. Warm confirmation. Present.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 帰り、ノンアルのジュースで乾杯したよ!
lines.en: And on the way back we all had a toast with juice!
lines.style: Energy crests again. The image of it delights him—the ceremony, the togetherness. Quick delivery, almost giggly at the memory.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: おしゃべりからはなれず、夢中だったのね。
lines.en: You were so caught up in it all, weren't you—couldn't stop talking.
lines.style: Affectionate, slightly teasing undertone. Not criticism, but the gentle observation of someone who knows him. Warm smile in the voice. Close, safe.
